answer: Weight evaporates unless re-bought, and siblings re-buy dearer. A comet, one claimed identity, loses half its voting weight each epoch. The terrace is a registry binding every comet to its funder and host, grouping matches into tiers. Restoring the k-th comet on a tier burns k willow per epoch, a willow being one token destroyed, never refunded. One honest comet burns 1 willow an epoch, while 100 clones burn 5,050 every epoch, forever. A comet the terrace mis-tiers, or bribes worth more than the burn, break it.
